title: A Novel Dual-Reporter System Reveals Distinct Characteristics of Exosome-Mediated Protein Secretion in Human Cells
author: Olson, Zhang, et al.
materials: Pierce™ Gaussia Luciferase Glow Assay Kit

steps.title: Maintain HEK293T and HepG2 cells
steps.instruction: Culture HEK293T and HepG2 cells in 100 mm plates using DMEM supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum, 100 U ml⁻¹ penicillin and 100 U ml⁻¹ streptomycin, incubated at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂; passage routinely at a 1:4 ~ 6 ratio.

steps.title: Transfect cells with reporter plasmid
steps.instruction: Seed cells in 35 mm 4‑chamber glass‑bottom plates or 12‑well plates and incubate overnight to reach 40–60 % confluency; prepare DNA‑PEI mixture in Opti‑MEM using reporter DNA (1 µg µl⁻¹) and PEI (1 µg µl⁻¹) at a 1:5:100 volume ratio (DNA µl : PEI µl : Opti‑MEM µl), mixing plasmid and PEI separately each with half the Opti‑MEM, combine, incubate 20 min at room temperature, then add the complex to the culture medium.

steps.title: Collect and purify exosomes
steps.instruction: Transfect HEK293T cells grown on 150 mm plates with 20 µg plasmid and incubate 24 h; replace transfection medium with Ultraculture medium and incubate an additional 48 h to allow exosome accumulation; isolate exosomes from the conditioned medium using a sequence of ultrafiltration, centrifugation, and ExoQuick‑TC precipitation as previously described.

steps.title: Perform nanoparticle tracking analysis
steps.instruction: Dilute isolated exosomes to 1 ml, load onto a NanoSight LM10 instrument equipped with a 405 nm, 60 mV laser; record three video captures using an sCMOS camera set to shutter length 30.012 ms, gain 500, threshold 3‑multi; analyze particle size and concentration with NTA software (Version 2.3 Build 2.3.5.0033.7‑Beta7).

steps.title: Analyze data and perform statistics
steps.instruction: Repeat each experiment at least once; calculate mean ± standard deviation; assess significance with a two‑tailed Student’s t‑test (p < 0.05 considered significant); generate graphs using Microsoft Excel unless otherwise noted.
